instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Define CSS custom variables in App.css or index.css matching the provided palette: --bg-espresso: #100B08, --bg-deep-brown: #1A0E08, --color-gold: #E2A34E, --color-amber: #FFB45E, --color-cream: #F5E9D8, --color-orange-glow: #FF7A00.
2. Use Google Fonts link in index.html for 'Playfair Display' (Serif) and 'Outfit' (Sans-Serif).
3. Implement the Loading Screen overlay that displays on initial load with progress 0-100%, then smoothly fades out using GSAP or CSS transition.

4. Create the 3D Coffee Cup Component in Three.js / R3F (@react-three/fiber + @react-three/drei): render a matte black cup geometry with gold emblem material, cream latte art circle surface, animated steam particles (Points or Canvas Sprite), floating coffee beans mesh with subtle rotation, and an orange point light (#FF7A00) positioning behind the cup for dramatic rim glow.
5. Build all interactive states for the Cart Drawer, Login Modal, Product Selection, Quantity Adjustment, and Order Success Popup.
6. Ensure all pricing is in Indian Rupees (₹599, ₹749, ₹799, ₹699).
7. Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements as requested.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Maintain APCA contrast ratios with cream text on dark coffee backgrounds.
Do NOT use Inter font for headings; stick strictly to Playfair Display for titles and Outfit for body.
Ensure all buttons have hover, active, and focus states with smooth 0.2s cubic-bezier transitions.
Add data-testid to every button, input, link, cart stepper, and section container.
